io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription: German land values (Bodenrichtwerte) by address: value per land-use type with valuation date and source reference. Data is set by the German expert committees for property values (Gutachterausschüsse für Grundstückswerte) and returned with the required dl-de/by-2-0 attribution. Coverage varies by federal state and is not available in Schleswig-Holstein, Sachsen and Bayern — see bodenrichtwert.ai/datengrundlagen. A private access service, not a government portal.

server.name: ai.bolthub/mcp
server.description: The bolthub API marketplace, L402 gateways, and your other MCP servers, on one Lightning budget.
server.title: bolthub

environmentVariables.description: LND REST API URL (recommended wallet; pair with LND_MACAROON). A wallet is optional — without one, free tools and marketplace search still work; paid calls return their payment challenge.
environmentVariables.name: LND_REST_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Hex-encoded macaroon for LND (use a pay-scoped macaroon in production). Required with LND_REST_HOST.
environmentVariables.name: LND_MACAROON

environmentVariables.description: Nostr Wallet Connect string — easiest setup, works with CoinOS, Alby Hub, Zeus, and more. Alternative to LND.
environmentVariables.name: NWC_URI

environmentVariables.description: LNbits instance URL (pair with LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY). Alternative wallet.
environmentVariables.name: LNBITS_URL

environmentVariables.description: Admin API key for LNbits. Required with LNBITS_URL.
environmentVariables.name: LNBITS_ADMIN_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Phoenixd HTTP API URL (pair with PHOENIXD_PASSWORD). Alternative wallet.
environmentVariables.name: PHOENIXD_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP password for Phoenixd. Required with PHOENIXD_URL.
environmentVariables.name: PHOENIXD_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Maximum sats the server may spend per session (process lifetime), across ALL sources. Unset = unlimited; 0 = free tools only. The config file's budget.sat takes precedence.
environmentVariables.name: BUDGET_SATS

environmentVariables.description: Optional bolthub API token, used only by the deploy_node / node_status Node Launcher tools.
environmentVariables.name: BOLTHUB_AUTH_TOKEN

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.affiliate_disclosure: Purchase routes returned by this server are affiliate-tracked: BotInfo may earn a commission when an order completes at the dealer. Prices are the dealer's own checkout reality on the verification date stated in each response, and no price, stock or regulatory claim is conditional on the commission.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.coverage: United States market today; the catalog states its own verification dates and says so when a model is quote-basis rather than priced.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.data_provenance: Every record carries the date its price and availability were last verified against the dealer's live checkout. Regulatory status is stated against the FCC's 2026 rule on covered robotics equipment and is not legal advice.
